uutiset.t: China’s Top Planner Seeks Faster Construction of State Projects
uutiset.s: China’s top planning agency urged local authorities to speed up the construction of government investment projects and disbursement of funds in a bid to spur growth in the world’s second-largest economy.

uutiset.t: China Military Bans SF Express From Procurement Over Misconduct
uutiset.s: SF Express Co., a leading Chinese delivery and logistics company, has been suspended from participating in military-wide procurement of goods, engineering and services over alleged violations.

uutiset.t: Fiber Network Operator Zayo Delays Public ABS Sale Until 2027
uutiset.s: Fiber-optic network operator Zayo Group Holdings Inc. is delaying the public-market leg of a planned asset-backed securities offering, while moving ahead with the privately placed portion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

uutiset.s: All year, investors have gorged themselves on whatever the AI trade served up. Hundreds of billions of dollars of stock sold to build out infrastructure. Near-daily bond offerings to pay for chips and data centers. History’s two largest IPOs.

uutiset.t: Canadian Stocks Enter a Correction as Metals, Tech Slip
uutiset.s: A key benchmark of Canadian equities entered a technical correction on Friday as a selloff pushed metals, technology and energy stocks lower.

uutiset.t: AI Selloff Spurs Haven Demand for Yen, Franc as Dollar Slips
uutiset.s: The Japanese yen and Swiss franc outperformed their major peers as growing doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom drove demand for havens and put pressure on the US dollar.
